value: Legendary miniguy JRPG with extensive narrative and difficult mini-size battles in the latter portion of the game.

High school detective Chijinda You is investigating a mysterious string of disappearances at Yabaize High School. 
Things take a turn when Chijinda and his friends are shrunk to minute size by technology seemingly ahead of its time developed by the Advanced Science Society (A.S.S.). Despite their predicament, they will have to find a way to stop the A.S.S. before they can wreak any more chaos.
